name: Han Jisoo
source:
She is a student at Bloomingdale University and a potential permanent occupant of Flower Lane. While short-term choices ultimately dictate what Taylor does and says in scenes, her true nature is that of an awkward, antisocial loner with little to no friends before her stay at Flower Lane. After she rooms with one of the three campus celebrities, however, she begins to open up, joking and chatting avidly with her roommate of choice for the duration of her stay at Flower Lane. She tends to have a sharp tongue and, while is kind, doesn't hold back when she thinks someone is messing with her.

From [url=https://maybeinteractive.fandom.com/wiki/Taylor_Jones]Maybe: Interactive Fandom Wiki
